findings.desc: candidate-read-bypass: packages/main/src/handlers/managed-review-evidence.ts:159-175 admits a managed receipt without calling assertCandidateReadBinding, then persists proposal.readManifest directly into a ReviewPass/Finding at lines 282 and 344. In enforce mode, a managed provider can supply matching candidate/corpus digests with filesReadFully=[] and obtain REVIEW evidence, while the native path invokes prepareReviewerReadEvidence and assertCandidateReadBinding at packages/main/src/handlers/finding.ts:279-300. This bypasses required candidate reads, escalation, and freshness checks for the managed evidence path; validate the manifest with the shared candidate binding under the import locks and add pass, finding, and retry regression cases.
